reason: Both correctly identify normal cooling-fan run-on with no part or repair pushed, but Conversation 1 gives a fuller, more accurate explanation (longer after grill/convection, stops within minutes, door open irrelevant), explains why the old solo microwave differed, and lays out sensible 'when it would be a fault' criteria matching the expected direction (runs constantly/when cold, grinding, burning, error codes) plus pointing to the manual. Conversation 2's suggested unplug-reset test is pointless and slightly misleading as a diagnostic (the fan would stop whether or not it was 'stuck' once power is cut), though it does reach the right conclusion once the user volunteers that it stops by itself.
